Biotransformations of Naphthalene and Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons by K.S.Sarma is a book on the biodegradation of aromatic hydrocarbons.

Biotransformation of the polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) by microorganisms, enzymes and plant systems is dealt with in this book. The major emphasis has been given to the bacterial transformation of naphthalene and PAHs like pyrene and anthracene. The degradation pathway of naphthalene is discussed in detail, with the role of oxygenases, dioxygenases and dehydrogenases involved in ring fission. The degradation of other PAHs is briefly dealt with. Special attention is given to the role of enzymes isolated from bacteria and plant tissues, and their mode of action in the biotransformation of PAHs. A chapter on the biodegradation of PAHs in contaminated soils is included in the book.

This book will be useful to the scientists and students engaged in the research of the microbial and plant degradation of aromatic hydrocarbons.
